This vignette walks through a full concept lifecycle: define, version, activate,
evaluate, compare, and deprecate.

## Setup

```{r}
library(conceptR)
library(duckdb)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb(), ":memory:")

bundle <- structure(
  list(
    object_types = list(
      list(id = "Patient", table_name = "patients", primary_key = "patient_id")
    )
  ),
  class = "ontology_bundle"
)

DBI::dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE patients (
    patient_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    age           INTEGER,
    comorbidities INTEGER
  )
")

set.seed(42)
for (i in 1:20) {
  DBI::dbExecute(con,
    "INSERT INTO patients VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
    params = list(paste0("PT", i), sample(30:85, 1), sample(0:5, 1)))
}

ctx <- concept_context(bundle, con)
```

## Define a concept

```{r}
cpt_define(ctx, "high_risk_patient", "Patient",
  description = "Patient at elevated clinical risk")
```

## Add and activate version 1

```{r}
cpt_add_version(ctx, "high_risk_patient", "clinical",
  sql_expr  = "age > 65 AND comorbidities > 2",
  rationale = "Initial risk threshold based on literature review",
  status    = "draft")

cpt_activate(ctx, "high_risk_patient", "clinical", version = 1L)
```

## Evaluate

```{r}
results_v1 <- cpt_evaluate(ctx, "high_risk_patient", "clinical")
cat("High-risk patients (v1):", sum(results_v1$high_risk_patient), "\n")
head(results_v1)
```

## Add a revised version and compare

Version 2 lowers the age threshold and adds a third comorbidity option.

```{r}
cpt_add_version(ctx, "high_risk_patient", "clinical",
  sql_expr  = "age > 60 AND comorbidities > 1",
  rationale = "Revised based on clinical audit — wider definition",
  status    = "draft")

diff <- cpt_compare_versions(ctx, "high_risk_patient", "clinical",
  version_a = 1L, version_b = 2L)

cat("V1 count:", diff$total_a, "\n")
cat("V2 count:", diff$total_b, "\n")
cat("In V1 only:", diff$only_a, "\n")
cat("In V2 only:", diff$only_b, "\n")
cat("Matching:  ", diff$match,  "\n")
```

## Activate v2 and deprecate v1

```{r}
cpt_activate(ctx, "high_risk_patient", "clinical", version = 2L)
cpt_deprecate(ctx, "high_risk_patient", "clinical", version = 1L)

cpt_get_version(ctx, "high_risk_patient", "clinical")$version
```

```{r include=FALSE}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
